result.feedback: The handover is source rich and correctly says full Project Eclipse conversation access was unavailable, but needs one targeted correction before acceptance. It mislabels a baseline issue as current: current working tree BanHangPOSPanel.java already registers VK_F9 (around line 1881), and has barcode input/scan handler (around lines 706,943), so matrix must mark these as implemented-in-working-tree/unverified-live and recommend focused UI validation, not say F9 is absent or tell us to add barcode/F9. Baseline A01-A15 and 11/25 failures refer to post-pull commit 224a140 and must be explicitly tagged historical baseline; several repairs are now present locally and the newest isolated regression run reports 25/25 (code-level fixes remain uncommitted and no production schema migration was run). Do not repeat old ownership task list as still-pending without checking against the current working tree; label repaired locally / needs branch commit separately where supported. Architecture statements like DAO handles 100% SQL and strict GUI separation are intended design rules, not verified conformance; phrase them as target rules and audit deviations. Add the user's direct newly stated scenarios to the matrix as unverified requirements to audit: products with absent price (reject sale/actionable manager fix, never silently zero), entity/line invoice price provenance and calculations, live-dashboard-to-SQL consistency, scan-first throughput, oversized service queue/work assignment, appointment late/no-show workflow and manager resolution, plus broader undiscovered cases. Preserve limitation that only 26 excerpted messages were available, avoid implying any actual complete prior-chat retrieval. Do not recommend production migrations; they require separate authorization. Keep the rest concise and traceable.
